# Safehinge Primera

> > Safehinge Primera designs and manufactures anti-ligature and anti-barricade doorsets for healthcare, mental health, education, and custodial environments across the UK.

Safehinge Primera is a UK-based company specializing in safety-focused door systems and components for high-risk environments. Their product portfolio includes complete doorsets (Symphony, Alumax, Alumini) and individual components (SOS, Sureview, Surehinge, Sureclose) designed to prevent ligature and barricade incidents in mental health facilities, prisons, schools, and other secure settings.
